title: Cone Invariance and Homoclinic Standing Waves for Cooperative Finite-Range DNLS Equations
summary: We develop a constrained-power variational framework for positive homoclinic standing waves in one-dimensional discrete nonlinear Schrödinger equations with cooperative finite-range interactions. Starting from periodic lattices, we construct constrained energy maximizers and use the associated projected gradient flow to establish positive invariance of the cone of nonnegative, even, and unimodal profiles.
